from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyMonetaryFund(BaseModel):
    """One company's monetary funds value from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the report")
    monetary_funds: float | None = Field(description="The monetary funds balance value")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit used (e.g., 元)")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The report period this data covers")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of report (e.g., 2024年第一季度财务报告)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the monetary funds value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies_monetary_funds: list[CompanyMonetaryFund]
